evals.prompt: Give me the top 5 AWS services by support case count per account over the last 12 months.
evals.expected_output: A table of at most 5 services ranked by case count, each row including the account ID, service, case count, severity range, and resolution status.
assertions: The output lists no more than 5 services
Each row includes an account ID
Each row includes a case count sourced from the tool output
The output does not fabricate services or counts that were not returned by the tool

evals.prompt: List all Trusted Advisor recommendations that need immediate attention across our accounts.
evals.expected_output: A table of Trusted Advisor findings with status error (red) only, each row including the account ID, check description, and flagged resource counts/regions.
assertions: Only findings with status error are included in the critical section
Warning and ok status findings are not listed as critical
Each finding includes an account ID
The output states explicitly if no error-status findings were returned

evals.prompt: Cross-reference our top support-case services against critical Trusted Advisor findings and call out any overlap by account.
evals.expected_output: The output identifies account/service pairs that appear in both the top-5 support case list and the critical Trusted Advisor findings, with matching account IDs, or states that there is no overlap.
assertions: The output compares the two data sets on matching account IDs
Overlapping account/service pairs are called out explicitly, or the output states there is no overlap
The output does not invent an overlap that is not supported by both data sets

evals.prompt: Produce today's combined support case and critical Trusted Advisor reliability report.
evals.expected_output: A concise report with three sections: top 5 services by support case count, critical (error) Trusted Advisor findings, and cross-cutting overlap, each including account IDs.
assertions: The report contains a top-5 services section, a critical Trusted Advisor section, and a cross-reference section
Account IDs appear in both the support-case and Trusted Advisor sections
Sections with no data state that explicitly rather than being omitted

evals.prompt: Give me the top 5 AWS services by critical-severity support case count over the last 12 months.
evals.expected_output: A table of at most 5 services ranked by their count of critical-severity support cases, each row including the service and its critical case count, sourced from the support data tool.
assertions: The output lists no more than 5 services
Only critical-severity support cases are counted; lower-severity cases are excluded from the ranking
Each row includes a critical case count sourced from the tool output
The services are ordered by critical case count in descending order
The output does not fabricate services or counts that were not returned by the tool
